title: Spectro-temporal receptive-field models of zebra finch auditory-forebrain neurons

data.paper: Le B, Bjoring MC, Meliza CD (2025). The zebra finch auditory cortex reconstructs occluded syllables in conspecific song. Nature Communications 16:8452. doi:10.1038/s41467-025-63182-y

method.spectrogram: 24 log-spaced bands 500-8000 Hz, 10 ms Hann window, 5 ms hop, dB, z-scored per band across all stimuli
method.model: Linear STRF, lags 0-95 ms, ridge regression on trial-averaged firing rate (5 ms bins, Gaussian smoothing sd 7.5 ms); output rectified at 0
method.validation: Leave-one-song-out over 8 songs: fit on all 9 conditions of 7 songs, test on the clean version of the held-out song. Ridge penalty chosen from {1e2,1e3,1e4,1e5} by mean held-out correlation (slightly optimistic).
method.reliability: Split-half correlation of trial-averaged responses to clean songs, Spearman-Brown corrected; the practical ceiling for any model.
